doc.brief: A layout manager for widgets with a single child.
doc.md:
A layout manager for widgets with a single child.

`GtkBinLayout` will stack each child of a widget on top of each other,
using the [`Widget:hexpand`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:hexpand), [`Widget:vexpand`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:vexpand),
[`Widget:halign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:halign), and [`Widget:valign`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#property:valign) properties
of each child to determine where they should be positioned.
